notes: Encoded independently from this page's own text; no usesStylesOf despite the page's sister-brand list (shared parent/sister listing alone does not establish a shared serial system, and this page states its own positions). The month letter (4th character) is chart-only and is not encoded; year and week are text-verified and ship.

styles.era: Dashed serials normalizing to 3 digits + 1 letter + 6 digits
styles.notes: Page positions 2-3 (1-based) = year, 4th character = month letter (chart-only, held), 9th-10th characters = week; all read on the normalized serial (dashes stripped), where the page example 1-99-C-9305-10 becomes 199C930510: year [1,3] = 99 -> 1999, week [8,10] = 10. Month unblocked by the page's nomenclature chart image (see report image-pass list).
